_comment: Known, already-reconciled migration history gaps between supabase/migrations/ and production as of 2026-08-24 (see PR #68). The drift-check workflow ignores exactly these versions so CI stays green without requiring us to reverse-engineer decades-old ad-hoc schema changes. Any NEW drift beyond this baseline fails the build. Do not add to this list to silence a check on migrations you're actively adding — that's what the check is for. Only add here if you've done the same live-schema verification PR #68 did and are documenting a deliberately-accepted historical gap.
